{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst 5 rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check the distribution of arms
print("\nDistribution of arm:", df['arm'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check the distribution of responded
print("\nDistribution of responded:", df['responded'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for re-tested patients
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().to_dict())

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print("\nAssay_batch distribution:", df['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict())"}
